**BLUF:** Ukrainian deep strikes hit the major Kstovo refinery overnight into 1 November, with fires and fuel restrictions reported; the Oleshky localized ceasefire enabled 167 evacuations but ended with renewed Russian strikes including on a Kherson hospital. Limpet-mine attacks on tankers near Hormuz continue with new navigational warnings and IRGC claims of multiple incidents. PLA activity around Taiwan remains at elevated but non-escalatory levels (19–32 sorties daily). North Korea tested the Hwasong-11D with a cluster warhead. Ethiopian government drone strikes in Tigray and SAF strikes in Sudan’s Nyala persist with rising civilian tolls. New space-debris and live-fire nav warnings issued in the South China Sea and Sulu Sea.[[1]](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/88777)[[2]](https://unn.ua/en/news/fire-point-confirmed-the-strike-on-the-kstovo-oil-refinery-one-of-russias-largest-oil-refineries)

## 1. CHATTER AND THE INFORMATION ENVIRONMENT

[HUMINT - CHATTER] Multiple accounts including @WW3finalboss and @Sulkhan report Ukrainian strikes on the LUKOIL-Nizhegorodnefteorgsintez refinery in Kstovo, Nizhny Novgorod, with video of fires and Zelenskyy stating the hits target Russia’s oil, diesel, and fuel supply; Russian authorities imposed gasoline purchase limits on 1 November. Reach appears moderate among pro-Ukraine and OSINT circles; no independent geolocation of new damage yet, but consistent with prior strikes on the facility.[[3]](https://x.com/Sulkhan/status/2117348519854109151)

[HUMINT - CHATTER] @IndefSCANDINAVIA and local accounts note Oleshky residents (especially men of military age) largely refused evacuation to Ukraine under the Melania-brokered truce, with returning civilians expressing strong anger at Zelenskyy and Ukrainian forces for abandonment in 2022, lack of flood aid in 2023, and ongoing shelling; some evacuees routed via Ukraine to Europe. Claims uncorroborated by Western outlets but circulating in Scandinavian-language and pro-Russian channels.[[4]](https://x.com/IndefSCANDINAV/status/2117357072878624900)

[OSINT - SOCIAL] @arya_explains and @golgeveri discuss additional tanker incidents in the Gulf/Hormuz (one 72 nm off Saudi Arabia, a tug in Hormuz) alongside the confirmed Louise 1 limpet-mine attack; IRGC posts claim 11 tankers hit since late October. Nav warnings corroborate fires and sinkings in the period; Iranian tally of 11 burning oil tankers lacks vessel-by-vessel verification.[[5]](https://x.com/golgeveri/status/2117230638726009307)

[OSINT - SOCIAL] @Osint_Ghost and @MoNDefense-linked accounts report ongoing PLA sorties (32 on 1 Nov with 26 median-line crossings; 19 on 2 Nov with 4 ADIZ entries) and naval activity around Taiwan; tone remains routine monitoring with no escalation signals.[[6]](https://x.com/avsec_pro/status/2117249515271209301)

[HUMINT - CHATTER] @ArmyRecognition and Ukrainian milbloggers note North Korea’s Hwasong-11D test with cluster warhead (claimed 12–13 ha impact area); analysis suggests effective coverage of ~7.5–8 ha. No Japanese or South Korean radar confirmation reported.[[7]](https://x.com/ArmyRecognition/status/2117239804601721276)

[HUMINT - CHATTER] @Dali_NEWSDN and Tigray accounts report continued Ethiopian drone strikes on civilian areas in Tigray (near Badme/Eritrea border) and power infrastructure; Sudan files UN/AU complaints citing 70+ Ethiopian drone attacks since February. WHO warns of health-system collapse from renewed fighting and strikes.[[8]](https://x.com/telesurenglish/status/2117353552813474054)

[HUMINT - CHATTER] Sudanese accounts highlight SAF drone strikes on Nyala market and infrastructure, with al-Burhan statements rejecting negotiations and vowing to target water, electricity, and fuel. Civilian toll rising with limited independent verification.[[9]](https://x.com/Dali_NEWSDN/status/2117203994179260517)

## 2. STANDING THEATRE SWEEP

### EUROPE / RUSSIA-UKRAINE
[OSINT - WEB] Kyiv Post and Fire Point confirm Ukrainian drone strike on Lukoil-Nizhegorodnefteorgsintez refinery in Kstovo (Russia’s fourth-largest, ~17 Mt/year capacity) overnight into 1 November, with multiple fires reported in processing units; Russian authorities tightened gasoline limits.[[1]](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/88777)[[2]](https://unn.ua/en/news/fire-point-confirmed-the-strike-on-the-kstovo-oil-refinery-one-of-russias-largest-oil-refineries)

[OSINT - WEB] Kyiv Independent reports Oleshky ceasefire held long enough for evacuation of 167 civilians (including 22 children) from right-bank Kherson; some residents remain seeking evacuation. Ceasefire ended with Russian strikes, including on a Kherson hospital.[[10]](https://x.com/tedsikkink/status/2117333410826088824)

[OSINT - WEB] Ukrainian Air Force and outlets report ongoing Russian drone/artillery strikes on energy and rail infrastructure (e.g., Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, Zaporizhzhia aid center killing 24); 433 drones launched overnight into 2 November.[[11]](https://x.com/WW3finalboss/status/2117329897681022985)

**Assessment:** Ukrainian deep strikes are measurably degrading Russian refining capacity while Russian pressure on Ukrainian infrastructure and civilians continues. The Oleshky truce produced a short humanitarian window but collapsed quickly. Likely to persist at current intensity. Moderate confidence (multiple independent outlets corroborate strikes and evacuations).

### MIDDLE EAST
[OSINT - WEB] gCaptain, Reuters, and maritime sources confirm Panama-flagged Louise 1 hit by two limpet mines ~25 nm NE of Khasab (engine-room fire extinguished, crew safe); additional tanker incidents reported in the Gulf. Iranian FM Araghchi described US outreach as a “positive step” while talks continue in Doha.[[5]](https://x.com/golgeveri/status/2117230638726009307)

[SIGINT - VERIFIED] NAVAREA XI 494/26 and China MSA Hainan warnings (issued 2 November) declare space-debris hazard areas in the Sulu Sea (051900Z–060100Z NOV) and rocket-debris zones in the South China Sea (5–6 November).[[12]](https://www.sealagom.com/navarea/11/message/25458/)

**Assessment:** The confirmed limpet-mine campaign marks deliberate escalation in Iran’s maritime pressure; unverified broader claims raise miscalculation risk. Insurance and shipping patterns likely to shift further. High confidence on Louise 1 (multiple maritime sources); moderate on broader tally.

### INDO-PACIFIC
[OSINT - WEB] Taiwan MND reports 32 PLA aircraft sorties (26 median-line crossings) on 1 November and 19 sorties (4 ADIZ entries) on 2 November, plus naval activity; routine monitoring tone with no escalation signals.[[13]](https://x.com/MoNDefense/status/2117059116766318790)

[SIGINT - VERIFIED] NAVAREA XI 493/26 and China MSA Guangdong/Zhejiang warnings (issued 1–2 November) declare gunnery and military-training areas in the northern South China Sea and East China Sea (3–7 November windows).[[12]](https://www.sealagom.com/navarea/11/message/25458/)

**Assessment:** Activity remains within established patterns; no signals of imminent escalation rehearsal. Unlikely to produce >40 sorties or sustained naval presence in the next 24h. High confidence (official MND and nav warnings).

### AFRICA
[OSINT - WEB] Africanews, Reuters, and MSF report SAF drone strike on Nyala market (Sudan) killing dozens (reports range 21–102).[[9]](https://x.com/Dali_NEWSDN/status/2117203994179260517)

[OSINT - WEB] Africanews and WHO report multiple Ethiopian drone strikes in northern Tigray since late October killed at least 25 civilians (including children); health system nearing collapse. Sudan files complaints with UN/AU over 70+ Ethiopian drone attacks.[[8]](https://x.com/telesurenglish/status/2117353552813474054)

**Assessment:** Civilian toll from drone strikes in Tigray and Sudan is rising with limited independent on-ground verification; international pressure remains low. Likely to persist. Moderate confidence.

### STRATEGIC AND SPACE
[SIGINT - VERIFIED] Multiple new China MSA and NAVAREA XI warnings (issued 1–2 November) for space-debris and live-fire areas in SCS, Sulu Sea, Bohai/Yellow Sea, and East China Sea through early November.[[12]](https://www.sealagom.com/navarea/11/message/25458/)

**Assessment:** Routine military and launch activity; no anomalous patterns. Quiet in window beyond announced exercises.

Other theatres (South/Central Asia, Americas, Economic/Energy beyond Hormuz) quiet in window beyond midterms coverage and routine incidents.

leads worked: 4 of 12 nav warnings carried (Sulu Sea/SCS space debris, SCS gunnery); 3 GDELT hotspots searched and carried (Kstovo, Hormuz, Tigray); 2 passed over (White House, Jerusalem) as no new verifiable movement.

## 3. TECHNOLOGY AND CYBERSECURITY
[OSINT - WEB] CISA added multiple Ivanti Connect Secure, GitLab, Cisco, VMware, and Linux Kernel vulnerabilities to KEV with confirmed active exploitation (including CVE-2026-118527 file-upload and CVE-2026-111357 privilege-escalation in Ivanti).[[14]](https://x.com/randyferrell/status/2117357300285382787)

**Assessment:** Active exploitation of Ivanti flaws continues to pose immediate risk to VPN infrastructure; patching deadlines are tight. High confidence (official CISA catalog).

## 4. HOMELAND AND INFRASTRUCTURE
Quiet in window beyond midterms coverage and routine incidents; no new events in searches.

## FORECAST CHECK
1. NOT TRIGGERED — No additional verified tanker strikes producing insurance spike or US/Israeli response planning reported in window.
2. NOT TRIGGERED — PLA activity reached 32 sorties/26 crossings but did not exceed 40 or show sustained naval presence.
3. NOT TRIGGERED — No verified >50 civilian deaths from Ethiopian drone strikes with independent confirmation in window.
4. OPEN — Russian strikes on Ukrainian energy continue but no nationwide blackouts reported yet.

## INDICATORS AND WARNINGS
- >40 PLA aircraft or sustained naval presence near Taiwan median line in next 24h → signals possible escalation rehearsal → Taiwan MND or PLA statements → unlikely.
- Verified additional limpet-mine or missile attack on tanker in Hormuz within 48h → insurance spike and potential US/Israeli response planning → UKMTO or CENTCOM advisory → roughly even chance.
- Verified >50 civilian deaths from Ethiopian/Sudanese drone strikes with independent confirmation → international pressure or sanctions discussion → African Union or UN statement → likely.
- Russian strikes causing nationwide Ukrainian blackouts → winter humanitarian crisis escalation → Ukrainian General Staff or regional reports → likely.

## COLLECTION GAPS
- Independent on-ground verification of civilian casualties and damage in Tigray and Sudan drone strikes.
- Confirmation of full extent of Kstovo refinery damage and operational impact.
- Vessel-by-vessel verification of IRGC’s “11 tankers” claim in Hormuz.
